notablePrerequisites:
Nardole has at least four counters on it.
Nardole does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Nardole by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast noncreature spells.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Nardole.
Resolve Clockspinning, putting a counter on Nardole, or putting/removing a counter from any other permanent you control, and then returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {U} that can only be spent to cast noncreature spells, you may target any other creature using Chakram Retriever's trigger.
